powers.title: Avenger's Resolve
powers.description: For a few moments, your faith infuses you with supernatural toughness.
rows: Trigger: An enemy other than your oath of enmity target hits you
Effect: You gain resist 5 to all damage until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Blessing of Vengeance
powers.description: With the death of your foe, your god grants you a boon.
rows: Trigger: Your oath of enmity target drops to 0 hit points
Effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to your healing surge value.

powers.title: Distracting Flare
powers.description: Divine light surrounds you, providing a distraction while you slip away unseen.
rows: Effect: You become invisible and move your speed. You are invisible until the end of the movement.

powers.title: Enduring Spirit
powers.description: The strength of your spirit shines most brightly in adversity.
rows: Requirement: You must be bloodied.
Effect: You gain a +4 bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Holy Blessing
powers.description: Kissing your holy symbol, you momentarily consider your next prey and how best to attack it.
rows: Trigger: Your oath of enmity target drops to 0 hit points
Target: One other enemy within range.
Effect: You use oath of enmity on the target. Until the end of your next turn, the target grants combat advantage to you.

powers.title: Loyal Sanction
powers.description: You bless your comrade's efforts to aid you in the defeat of your chosen foe.
rows: Target: One ally in the burst
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, the target gains a power bonus to damage rolls against your oath of enmity target equal to your Wisdom.

powers.title: Refocus Enmity
powers.description: After searching your soul, you realize who your true foe is and swear an oath against it.
rows: Target: One creature you can see in the burst
Effect: The target becomes the target of your oath of enmity, replacing the current target.

powers.title: Resonant Escape
powers.description: A quick prayer as you dodge calls forth divine power, which carries you a short distance away.
rows: Trigger: An enemy hits or misses you with a melee attack
Effect: You teleport 3 squares.

powers.title: Righteous Pursuit
powers.description: Try as your enemy might, there's no escaping your wrath.
rows: Trigger: Your oath of enmity target ends its turn in a square not adjacent to you
Effect: You shift a number of squares equal to your Wisdom and must end this movement as close to your oath of enmity target as possible.

powers.title: Silver Shadow
powers.description: You cloak yourself in astral mist, which guards you from harm.
rows: Effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to 5 + your level. You also gain concealment, which lasts until you have no temporary hit points.

powers.title: Aspect of Agility
powers.description: You move with the speed of the west wind, leaving your foes with little chance of striking you.
rows: Effect: You shift 5 squares, and you gain a +2 bonus to AC and Reflex until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Aspect of Majesty
powers.description: Your faith fills you with courage and mystically extends the reach of your attacks.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you gain a +1 bonus to Will, and your melee reach increases by 1.

powers.title: Cloaked Steps
powers.description: Shadows cling to you whenever you move, like a lover's embrace.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, if you move more than 2 squares on your turn, you gain concealment until the start of your next turn.

powers.title: Fortifying Chant
powers.description: You recite holy verses, armoring yourself with the strength of your faith.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you gain a +1 bonus to AC and Fortitude. In addition, whenever you reduce your oath of enmity target to 0 hit points, this bonus increases to +4 until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Harsh Lesson
powers.description: You seek penance in the hope that your faults might be corrected.
rows: Trigger: You miss every target with an avenger attack power
Effect: You take 5 damage, and you gain a +2 power bonus to attack rolls until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Oath of Enduring Wrath
powers.description: You swear to defeat your enemies, and your god grants you the perseverance to overcome any hindrance.
rows: Effect: You gain a +2 power bonus to saving throws until the end of the encounter.

powers.title: Oath of the Relentless Hunter
powers.description: You touch an enemy and swear an oath to hunt it to the end of the world. With this oath, you can always find your foe.
rows: Target: One creature

Effect: Until you use this power on a different target, you can take a standard action to determine the distance and the direction to the target. The distance and the direction are based on a straight line between you and the target, ignoring any barriers. If the target is on a different plane from you, you know which plane but gain no other information.

powers.title: Prayer of Sacrifice
powers.description: You are unwilling to fail your god and make a personal sacrifice to help ensure your success with the task at hand.
rows: Effect: You enter the sacrificial prayer stance. Until the stance ends, when you miss all targets with an encounter attack power, you can choose to take 10 damage that cannot be reduced or negated by any means. If you do so, you regain the use of the encounter attack power.

powers.title: Soul Seeker
powers.description: You call forth a spirit of necromantic hunger, allowing it to harvest the life force of your enemies.
rows: Effect: A soul-consuming spirit from the land of the dead appears in an unoccupied square within range. The soul seeker counts as an ally for the purpose of flanking. Whenever you reduce an enemy that is adjacent to the soul seeker to 0 hit points or fewer, you heal a number of hit points equal to your Wisdom. If you reduce the target of your oath of enmity to 0 hit points or fewer, you can use your oath of enmity power as a free action against a target adjacent to your soul seeker.
Sustain Minor: The soul seeker persists and you can move it 5 squares. The soul seeker ignores difficult terrain. The soul seeker vanishes at the end of your turn if it is out of your line of sight.

powers.title: Step of Fate
powers.description: Your world is in motion with your sworn enemy as its center.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you can use a free action to shift 1 square as the first action on each of your turns. You can't end this movement farther away from your oath of enmity target than you started.

powers.title: Wrath of the Divine
powers.description: Suffering a foe's lucky attack, you call on your god to visit your pain upon the one you have sworn to kill.
rows: Trigger: An enemy scores a critical hit against you
Target: Your oath of enmity target in the burst
Effect: The target takes radiant damage equal to the critical hit's damage.

powers.title: Avenger's Readiness
powers.description: As your opponents prepare to strike, you make a sudden move to spoil their plans.
rows: Trigger: You roll initiative at the beginning of an encounter
Effect: You gain a +5 power bonus to the initiative check. You shift 3 squares as a free action when the first creature in the initiative order starts its turn, even if you're surprised.

powers.title: Channel Endurance
powers.description: You focus your inner strength and tap into your god's power to forestall an injury.
rows: Effect: You gain resist 5 to all damage until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Decaying Presence
powers.description: Your presence decays your enemy's defenses, allowing your prayers to strike without interference.
rows: Effect: Choose one resistance to a damage type possessed by your oath of enmity target. Until you reduce your oath of enmity target to 0 hit points, any enemy adjacent to you does not benefit from any resistance to this damage type.

powers.title: Ever Onward
powers.description: You breathe the words of a restorative prayer. New vigor and swiftness course through you.
rows: Effect: You can spend a healing surge. In addition, you gain a +2 power bonus to speed until the end of the encounter.

powers.title: Eye of Justice
powers.description: Your eyes glow with divine energy, allowing you to spot foes no matter how well they hide.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you can see invisible creatures within 5 squares of you.

powers.title: Leading Step
powers.description: After your enemy strikes, you teleport away. An instant later, you bring the enemy after you.
rows: Trigger: An enemy adjacent to you damages you
Target: The triggering enemy
Effect: You teleport 5 squares and then teleport the target to a square adjacent to you.

powers.title: River of Life
powers.description: Divine power flows through you, allowing you to shrug off injury after injury.
rows: Effect: You gain regeneration 5 until the end of the encounter.

powers.title: Shielding Symbol
powers.description: You channel divine power through your holy symbol to shield yourself.
rows: Trigger: You are hit by an attack
Effect: Make a Wisdom attack using your implement. The result is your defense against the triggering attack.

powers.title: Wings of Vengeance
powers.description: Ephemeral wings carry you across the battlefield to strike where you are most needed.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a fly speed of 7, and you can hover.
